name: Chancellors
description: The Spanish Chancellors were a Latino street gang founded in 1960 at 27th and Normal in the Bridgeport neighborhood of Chicago. Formed alongside the first Mexican migration to Bridgeport, the gang fought back against Italian gangs amid widespread racial hostility toward Mexican residents. They allied with the Latin Counts of Pilsen and the Saints of Back of the Yards, and battled rivals including the Latin Kings and Insane Popes. The Chancellors were exclusive to Bridgeport with no satellite chapters and remained active through the 1980s and 1990s before disbanding around 2000.
